description: This Dart source file defines the ExportService class, which provides cross-platform export functionality for saving a sample PDF asset to user-selected locations, handling platform-specific behaviors via the file_selector package.

classes.name: ExportService
classes.description: Provides methods to export a bundled PDF asset to a user-selected location, handling platform-specific save dialogs and file writing.

methods.name: exportSamplePdfToUserLocation
methods.description: Exports the sample PDF asset to a user-chosen location using the system save dialog, returning a path or URI string indicating where the file was saved.

methods.name: _loadSamplePdfBytes
methods.description: Loads the sample PDF bytes from the app's asset bundle.

methods.name: _friendlyMessage
methods.description: Converts an error object into a simplified, user-friendly message.
